Graduate Engineering Academic Programs
Graduate Engineering Academic Programs
Graduate-level study prepares you with the skills to thoughtfully lead and strategically address problems in the workplace. The Russ College of Engineering and Technology offers a variety of graduate programs, giving you the freedom to choose the program that best fits your personal and professional goals in your chosen discipline.
As a leading research institution, our graduate students collaborate with accomplished faculty who have both research and industry experience on innovative projects. We prepare our graduates with the tools and experience to create an impact that lasts a lifetime.
Program Finder
We offer master's and doctoral programs on campus and online. Explore our programs in biomedical, chemical, civil, electrical, industrial, systems, and mechanical engineering, as well as computer science, program management.
Find what you’re looking for by using the filters and search bar.

Graduate Assistance in Areas of National Need (GAANN) Fellowship
The Graduate Assistance in Areas of National Need (GAANN) Fellowship is available to graduate students with the goal of becoming university faculty members or other high-impact researchers. The fellowship is awarded based on academic performance and financial need, upon the approval of the Graduate School and the corresponding department hosting a fellowship.
